This '''skirmish''' took place on the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jysella Horn]] was stricken with a mysterious [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that made her believe that everyone she knew had been replaced by impostors, she began to attack civilians, [[Telekinesis/Legends|tossing]] them across the Processional Way. Two of her friends, [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], were at a nearby [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] and witnessed her rampage. Realizing what had happened to her, they attempted to stop Horn, but she [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|attacked]] them, using [[flow-walking]] to predict their movements. After slashing Warv in the chest, she attempted to flee, only to be cut off and captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces shortly after. Horn was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and eventually placed in a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] and several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon arrived, and Saav'etu and Warv were taken back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for healing and debriefing.
